title: Differentially-private mean via the Gaussian mechanism with bounded inputs — morie_dp_gaussian_mean
text: Releases approximately (\(\epsilon\), \(\delta\))-DP mean bounded numeric vector. Sensitivity derived user-asserted bounds: changing one record can shift sum upper - lower, mean's sensitivity (upper - lower) / length(x).

title: Differentially-private mean via the Gaussian mechanism with bounded inputs — morie_dp_gaussian_mean
Differentially-private mean via the Gaussian mechanism with bounded inputs — morie_dp_gaussian_mean
text: x Numeric vector (NAs). lower, upper Hard bounds x. Caller must guarantee (x >= lower & x <= upper); function clips defensively emits warning clipping necessary. epsilon, delta Privacy parameters. Standard recommendation: delta < 1/length(x), epsilon 0.1 5.0.

title: Differentially-private mean via the Gaussian mechanism with bounded inputs — morie_dp_gaussian_mean
text: noised mean (single numeric).

title: Differentially-private mean via the Gaussian mechanism with bounded inputs — morie_dp_gaussian_mean
text: noise standard deviation follows classical analytic-Gaussian calibration: $$\sigma = \frac{\Delta \cdot \sqrt{2 \ln(1.25/\delta)}}{\epsilon}.$$

title: Differentially-private mean via the Gaussian mechanism with bounded inputs — morie_dp_gaussian_mean

what: Connected to the shared rmorie C core
title: rmoriedata (development version)
text: rmoriedata now declares LinkingTo: rmoriebricklayer (>= 0.2.0) links ecosystem’s shared compiled core instead duplicating C code. New exports morie_core_sha256() morie_core_mean() call shared kernels directly (fast data-integrity hashing + summaries integrated fixtures, dependency rmorie). Tests assert byte-identical rmoriebricklayer’s core_sha256() / core_mean().

what: New exported helpers — differential privacy + re-identification risk
title: rmoriedata (development version)
text: Six small, base-R-helpers analysts releasing aggregate statistics integrated fixtures (dataset) without re-identification risk: morie_dp_laplace_count() — (epsilon, 0)-DP count via Laplace mechanism (sensitivity 1). morie_dp_gaussian_mean() — approximate (epsilon, delta)-DP mean bounded numeric vector via analytic Gaussian mechanism. morie_dp_laplace_histogram() — per-bin Laplace noise histogram. morie_k_anonymity_verify() — checks k-anonymity set quasi-identifiers returns offending equivalence classes. morie_l_diversity_verify() — per-class distinct-count check sensitive attribute. morie_cell_suppress() — small-cell suppression optional complementary suppression primary-suppressed cells can’t reconstructed row/column marginals (StatCan-style). helpers use base R + existing stats import; new runtime dependencies. Inputs validated edge cases (empty vectors, NAs, --bounds inputs, invalid privacy parameters) throw informative errors.
